observation: Owner clarified that A.L.I.C.E. will be used primarily through voice, so identity fidelity requires expressive delivery control in addition to lexical choice.
builder_lesson: When the dominant interaction modality changes the observable personality surface, make that modality a first-class output contract before large-scale training. Preserve subsystem boundaries: identity policy selects expressive intent; replaceable renderer realizes acoustics.
action: Added voice-first EIPM contract, eight public N0 voice-expression competencies, separate eval-only voice benchmark, and a governed 40-row voice teaching shard. Elaina-specific expressive behavior remains later private identity material.

observation: Teacher-bank audit failed immediately with ModuleNotFoundError for alice_personality. Host wrapper exported PYTHONPATH, but magnolia_udocker_exec.sh did not forward PYTHONPATH into the validated container.
builder_lesson: A fail-fast import error with a clear environment-boundary cause should receive one root-cause repair, not trigger repeated runtime qualification. Environment variables required by code inside a container must cross the container boundary explicitly.
action: Forward PYTHONPATH through magnolia_udocker_exec.sh and rerun one upgraded voice-first teacher-bank audit; no GPU or network work.
